component.name: 7zipLX
component.summary: Native Linux GUI for the 7-Zip archive engine

description.p: 7zipLX is a Linux desktop archive manager built with Qt 6. It reuses the portable 7-Zip engine for archive formats, compression, extraction, testing and hashing.
It provides a two-panel file manager with drag and drop between local folders and archives, archive browsing, encrypted archives, multi-volume archives and a native Linux user interface.

Nested archive editing now writes the modified inner archive back to its parent archive recursively. Supports update-capable 7z, ZIP, TAR and single-file compressor containers, with clear preflight errors for split-volume and read-only outer formats.

Fixes nested-archive editing failures, adds clear protection for read-only nested archives, modernizes all dialogs with aligned form fields and themed input/message prompts, and polishes control, tab and progress styling.

Dual-pane drag and drop between local folders and archives, multi-selection drags, folder-row drop targets, archive-to-archive transfers, cross-pane clipboard operations, active-pane highlighting and Tab switching.
